name: CubingUSA Southeast Championship 2019

venue.name: [Charlotte Convention Center](https://www.charlottemeetings.com/charlotte-convention-center)
venue.address: 501 S College St, Charlotte, North Carolina 28202

information:
This competition is supported by CubingUSA as the Southeast Regional Championship of 2019.
Anyone from any location is allowed to compete. However only the competitors from the following states are eligible for the title of Southeast Champion: Alabama, Florida, Georgia, North Carolina, Puerto Rico, South Carolina, Tennessee, and United States Virgin Islands.

All competitors must read the "Competitor Information" tab prior to registering.
Please read all tabs prior to the competition and regularly check your email for updates from us. All contact will be made by email.
